positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for maximizing the store*s sales and profits and for achieving customer service objectives through personal selling and the effective management of Associates.
Surpassed Company*s goal of 11% profit for 2009 by profited 13.2%.
Maintained less than a 6% net sales loss despite a 15% loss in customer count.
Led the only Store in the Sales Region to make profit for first part of 2010. (Store had a profit of $31,623 while the sales region was down $24,378.)
Received a perfect mystery shop score twice in 2009.
Recruited, interviewed and hired a high caliber and diverse staff of sales associates.
Actively coached and developed associate relationships, to ensure that store met all corporate and regional sales and merchandising goals.
Trained other general managers within sales region in understanding of S.O.P. (Store Operating Profit) concepts.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Co-managed store operations for one of Pearle Vision*s flagship stores, helping to maintain annual sales of over $1.8 million.
Responsible for maintaining associates focus on achieve corporate and store sales goals, completed all store inventory orders and processing store insurance claims. 
Received a perfect mystery shop score the 2008.
Completed Corporate*s Basic Management Training (B.M.T.), Circle of Trusted Eyewear Training (C.O.T.E.) and OptiCam Operating System Training.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: Supervised associates in sales activities; responsible for assisting associates in implementing strategies to achieve corporate and store sales goals.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
August 2004
Supervised all associates on sales floor and in stockroom maintaining employee focus on achieving store sales and customer service goals. 
Averaged at least 50% sales gain.
Achieved "#1 Store in the Sales District" in January 2002. 
Completed Silver Level Management training program. 
Achieved 100% sales gain on over 20 occasions. 
Advanced; within six weeks.

positions.title: Key Holder/Sales Associate
positions.description:
Responsible for opening and closing the store and directed all store operations when manager was not available. 
Consistently achieved at least one-third of store's total sales. 
Ranked in Pearle Vision*s Top Ten Sales People in the Nation in 2001
Advanced from sales representative to key-holder with management responsibilities within one year. 
Directed all product merchandising efforts.
